title: Unified Cloud Pricing JSON Exchange
description: JSON exchange representation of the canonical cloud list-price catalog. Same 24 fields as unified_pricing.table-schema.json; optional missing CSV values are represented by null or omitted properties. Pricing units and pricing dimensions must be preserved when comparing prices.

ServiceProviderName.title: Service Provider
ServiceProviderName.description: FOCUS v1.4 ServiceProviderName, Name of the entity that provides the service. Constant per source file

ServiceCategory.title: Service category
ServiceCategory.description: FOCUS v1.4 ServiceCategory, Highest-level classification of the service, used for cross-provider comparison. Container services are classified as Compute and backup services as Storage

ServiceName.title: Service name
ServiceName.description: FOCUS v1.4 ServiceName, Display name of the service offering (e.g. Virtual Machines, Compute Engine, Amazon RDS). Each ServiceName belongs to exactly one ServiceCategory

SkuId.title: SKU id
SkuId.description: FOCUS v1.4 SkuId, Provider-specified identifier of the SKU. Unique only together with ServiceProviderName. The same SkuId can appear in several rows that differ in price tier, commitment term or pricing category

ChargeDescription.title: Charge description
ChargeDescription.description: FOCUS v1.4 ChargeDescription, Human-readable description of the charge, for display only

RegionId.title: Region id
RegionId.description: FOCUS v1.4 RegionId, Provider region identifier (e.g. southamerica-west1, brazilsouth). Empty for rows without a single region, such as AWS data transfer between regions

PricingCategory.title: Pricing category
PricingCategory.description: FOCUS v1.4 PricingCategory, Pricing model of the price. Standard = predetermined rate, including on-demand, pay-as-you-go and tiered pricing. Dynamic = variable rate set by the provider (Spot, preemptible, Azure Low Priority). Committed = reduced price under a commitment discount (reservations, savings plans, committed use discounts). Other = none of these

PricingUnit.title: Pricing unit
PricingUnit.description: FOCUS v1.4 PricingUnit, Normalized unit that ListUnitPrice refers to. Provider spellings (Hrs, hours, GBy.h, ...) are mapped to these values before import

ListUnitPrice.title: List unit price (USD)
ListUnitPrice.description: FOCUS v1.4 ListUnitPrice, List price per PricingUnit, in USD

SkuName.title: SKU name / instance type
SkuName.description: Custom column, Instance type or SKU name (e.g. Standard_D14, db.r5d.24xlarge). Empty when the provider data has no such name (GCP)

PriceComponent.title: Price component
PriceComponent.description: Custom column, What the price covers: a whole instance or one component such as CPU or RAM (GCP prices these separately). Not FOCUS ResourceType, which describes a billed resource and must be null without a ResourceId.

StorageClass.title: Storage class
StorageClass.description: Custom column, Conditional: storage services. Access tier of the stored data: Standard, InfrequentAccess (S3 IA, Azure Cool, Nearline), Cold (Coldline), Archive, or Automatic (S3 Intelligent-Tiering, Autoclass). Empty otherwise

ServiceTier.title: Service tier
ServiceTier.description: Custom column, Conditional: databases and compute. Provider edition or tier that changes the price for the same size (e.g. General Purpose, Memory Optimized, Enterprise, Enterprise Plus). Empty otherwise

RegionGroup.title: Region group
RegionGroup.description: Custom column, Coarse geographic group derived from the region by lookup table, so regions of different providers can be compared. Empty when RegionId is empty

CommitmentTerm.title: Commitment term
CommitmentTerm.description: Custom column, Length of the commitment on Committed prices. Empty for Standard and Dynamic prices. FOCUS has no commitment term column

CommitmentType.title: Commitment type
CommitmentType.description: Custom column, Kind of commitment behind a Committed price: Reservation (bound to a specific resource, usage-based) or SavingsPlan (spend-based). Empty for Standard and Dynamic prices. FOCUS CommitmentDiscountType requires a CommitmentDiscountId, which a price catalog does not have

Tenancy.title: Tenancy
Tenancy.description: Custom column, Shared hardware (default) or dedicated / sole-tenant hardware. Empty when not applicable

OperatingSystem.title: Operating system
OperatingSystem.description: Custom column, Operating system when the price depends on it. Empty otherwise

TierStart.title: Tier start
TierStart.description: Custom column, Start of the price tier, in PricingUnit terms. Empty when the price has no tiers

TierEnd.title: Tier end
TierEnd.description: Custom column, End of the price tier, in PricingUnit terms. Empty when the tier is open-ended (AWS writes Inf)

DatabaseEngine.title: Database engine
DatabaseEngine.description: Custom column, Engine of database services (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server). Empty otherwise

DeploymentOption.title: Deployment option
DeploymentOption.description: Custom column, Availability setup of database services (e.g. Single-AZ, Multi-AZ). Empty otherwise

VCpu.title: vCPU count
VCpu.description: Custom column, Number of vCPUs, used as a performance proxy. Empty when it could not be extracted

MemoryGiB.title: Memory (GiB)
MemoryGiB.description: Custom column, Memory in GiB, used as a performance proxy. Empty when it could not be extracted
